subject: SLA bundle scaling & early-renewal incentive discussion
messages:
From: Samir Patel <opslead@briskpay.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy.chen@briskpay.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SLA bundles + early renewal incentives

Hey Mateo,

Quick one — we’re looking at your SLA bundles for our payments platform. Two main asks: 1) can you map expected monthly cost delta if we move from the Standard uptime band to Premium (99.95 -> 99.99) at our current commit? and 2) is there an incentive if we sign an early 12-month renewal now rather than waiting until April?

We’ll likely need stronger escalation coverage (two-hour response for Sev1, on-call rotation) and a small allocation of playbook onboarding time. Amy is on copy for security and legal.

Can you send a sketch with numbers and a suggested timeline? We’ll share with procurement next week.

Thanks,
Samir
Ops Lead — BriskPay

Attachments: none
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <opslead@briskpay.com>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy.chen@briskpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA bundles + early renewal incentives

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear asks. Draft below; I’ve attached a quick spreadsheet with the ballpark math (SLA_Bundle_Tiers_v3.xlsx). High level:

- Premium uptime (99.99) vs Standard at your commit level increases unit pricing ~14% given the dedicated on-call and prioritized capacity lanes.
- Two-hour Sev1 response and a designated on-call rotation are included in the Premium bundle; add-on playbook onboarding (8 hours) is a one-time services fee.
- Early renewal: we can offer a 7% credit applied to the first three billing cycles if you execute a 12-month renewal by March 1. If BriskPay commits to a 12-month reserved capacity uplift (10% higher commit), we can extend that to a 10% credit and reduce the per-unit uplift to ~10%.

Suggested next steps:
1) Review the attached sheet and confirm which bundle variant you want (Premium base vs Premium+Onboarding).
2) If you want the early-renewal credit, sign the renewal LOI by March 1 — we’ll route to legal for a short amendment.
3) I’ll loop in Marissa to review discount approval and approve the credit terms if needed.

I’ll be available Monday for a 30-minute walk-through.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: SLA_Bundle_Tiers_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <opslead@briskpay.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA bundles + early renewal incentives

Thanks for the draft, Mateo — quick internal note and proposed approval path:

- 7% credit for execution by March 1 is okay up to $50k total credit for standard commit sizes; for larger credits we need a fast-track approval from Sales Ops.
- If they uplift commit by >=10% and want 10% credit we require VP review.
- Onboarding services fee should be itemized on the SOW (we prefer to bill one-time).

Samir — if you can confirm projected spend for the next 12 months (rough ARR number) I can fast-track discount authority and confirm whether we can take your case to VP to push the 10% threshold. Also, do you prefer credits applied as invoice credit or dollar discount on the renewal?

Marissa
Director, GTM Finance — Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Samir Patel <opslead@briskpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy.chen@briskpay.com>, Legal - BriskPay <contracts@briskpay.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA bundles + early renewal incentives

Marissa — thanks. Projected spend (estimate) for next 12 months: $1.1M (we expect seasonal peaks but that’s the midline). Prefer credit applied as a dollar discount on the renewal invoice rather than a line-item credit. We’d also like the onboarding hours included as a billable SOW but delivered in Q2.

Happy to have Legal take the LOI/amendment draft once you send.

Samir

Samir — perfect, thanks for the ARR estimate and preference. I’ve attached a short Mutual Action Plan (Mutual_Action_Plan_BRK-4721.pdf) that reflects:

- Target: sign renewal amendment by 2026-03-01 for 12-month renewal.
- Commercial: 7% invoice discount applied up front across the first 3 months; if commit uplift >=10% and sign by Mar 1, we’ll target 10% and require VP sign-off (I’ve flagged that with Marissa).
- Services: onboarding SOW (8 hours) billed as a one-time line item, delivery window Q2.
- Ops: Premium SLA (99.99), Sev1 two-hour response, designated on-call rotation, quarterly playbook review.

Kimberly — can you review the proposed discount flow and confirm how quickly Sales Ops can route this to VP if BriskPay confirms uplift? Also looping Legal (contracts@briskpay.com) for LOI intake.

If everyone’s good I’ll prepare the LOI and the amendment draft; we can target a short call Wednesday morning if helpful.

Thanks — Mateo
